title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. lusitanica
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. lusitanica, commonly known as Kidney Vetch, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Kidney Vetch include demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Kidney Vetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
